title: breakout_2 phone executor stays open indefinitely: independent watchdog + liveness reporting + standalone stale-heartbeat alert
note: MEASURED 2026-10-13: heartbeat stopped ~15:14Z, next event app_started 18:48Z (operator reopened). Cause (supported, not fully separable): the tick loop lived in MainActivity's scope; once the Activity/process died nothing relaunched it (service only relaunched on boot/update; sticky restart with a null intent did nothing). Fix: Liveness.kt + KeepAliveService watchdog (60 s) + AlarmManager chain + loop_restarted event + heartbeat fields (battery_exempt, overlay, fgs_running, alarm_exact, last_restart_reason, restarts_24h, app_version) + tap-here notifications. Alert: the probe was NEVER muted (the glyph is the breach marker); it rode only the collapsed Manager-watch section of the hourly manager digest. scripts/ops/phone_hb_alert.py sends a standalone system-channel alert + one recovery. Operator OK for the Tier-2 change: the 2026-10-13 ask (recorded_decision operator_decision).  | OPEN FOLLOW-UP: the stale-heartbeat alert rides the hourly carrier (latency <= ~70 min); a 5-min detection needs its own timer (deploy/*.timer + cadence-liveness registration), not built. The Kotlin is compiled and unit-tested only by CI (phone-executor-apk.yml); no Android SDK in lane sandboxes. Closes when the observation holds on an installed build. [2026-10-17 RESEARCH-AUTHOR-GRADE-1017] Field state (read-only GET /api/bot/prop/status?account_id=breakout_2 at 20:58Z, and main f03d9032): the fix IS on main (tools/phone-executor/.../Liveness.kt, scripts/ops/phone_hb_alert.py wired via scripts/ops/work_digest_now.py) and the installed build reports battery_exempt/fgs_running/alarm_exact all true, app_version 1b.263/263, heartbeat age under 1 min. The 48h observation is NOT closable: the API returns ~40 events (17:04Z-20:50Z, ~3.8 h), within which heartbeat events show 8 gaps over 10 min (max ~29 min; whether heartbeat events are logged per beat or on change is not established, so this is not a measured outage), and restarts_24h=5 with last_restart_reason=app_update, two app_started at 20:47Z, i.e. APKs are being reinstalled today (BREAKOUT-SL-AMEND-CLICK work), which resets any 48h window. State moved in_flight -> landed_unproven; due_by re-dated 2026-10-21. The 5-minute detection timer remains unbuilt (alert latency ~70 min via the hourly digest). [BACKLOG-DRAIN-2 2026-11-01] PENDING: NOT MET. phone_heartbeat 2026-11-01T14:25Z: app_version 1b.311, fgs_running true, battery_exempt true, restarts_24h 3, last_restart_reason activity_missing(service_tick), bg_runs 5 bg_ok 5. 3 restarts/24h means gaps happened; the API returns only the newest ~40 phone events so a 48h gap audit cannot be done from one read.
